Remove visible notches in italic ж and upper shoulder kink of з. ж: remove k branch stubs; redraw clean stem with native weight; correct bowl shoulder tangent. з: outgoing handle y487 to489; contour deviation ~1 unit. Per-glyph assertions and enlarged proof.
Default italic г: exact native dotlessi body from locl SRB imacron, without uni0304. Preserve SRB/MKD macron and printed ss04; retain previous construction source and 1.100 archive.
Italic ғ derives from the selected default г body with a merged crossbar at y236–266, fitted overhangs, advance 288 and shared mark anchors.

Italic д was clipped at y0, leaving a 74-unit chord. Restore the native q bowl overshoot at -9; preserve accepted advance 432 through a spacing override. Descender profile deviation at most 0.7 units.
Italic я lower bowl was nine units at its hairline. Deepen the native g bowl clipping ellipse to yield 15 units, preserve advance 413 and keep the junction smooth.

Remove the remaining visible donor seams in italic я: replace the top g-bowl/q-stem notch and lower link/stem triangular spur with tangent-matched quadratic splines; preserve bowl, counter, advance 413 and bearings.
Regular я: replace both sharp leg-to-bowl shoulders with compact tangent-matched quadratic curves; preserve advance 428, bearing -6, bounds, bowl, terminals and overall proportions.
Regular я: remove the remaining kink on the inner left edge of the right foot by making its adjacent quadratic controls exactly collinear; preserve all metrics and bounds.

Author confirmed that Regular я right-foot edge was still uneven in 1.106. Replace the whole left edge from (346,-9) to (280,95) with one convex cubic. Replace the single-node regression with a complete edge-profile convexity test that fails on 1.106.

Inventory all glyphs for the same waves and construction seams as ya. After the author noted defects in nearly all initial crops, review complete transitions, remove micro-steps, restore true straight edges, and store 39 Regular / 49 Italic (including two final sheared prime sources) exact reviewed quadratic sources after provisional polish and before kerning.

Author reports ya defects in both styles and locates the Regular issue at the top. Match exported crown curvature of Regular ya; remove the short Italic stem jog and terminal corner. Preserve all other outlines and all metrics against release 1.108.

OTF rounding/fitting can reintroduce a crown irregularity absent from the reviewed TTF. Export both ya glyphs by exact degree elevation with fractional CFF controls; verify all cubic controls within 0.002 units. Measured drift below 0.0001 units.

Widen the default Italic ghe; choose +20 advance units (~7%) by extending flourishes with the diagonal stem intact. Synchronize barred ghe and shift mark anchors +10; keep Regular and local/printed forms. Remove the exact-native alias classification for the authored default Cyrillic ghe.

First contour-audit repair batch: confirm adjacent-quadratic self-crossings and remove only the small loops at pointed Italic ц/щ/ң tail/body joins. Preserve all other points, forms, metrics, marks and shaping. Export these three CFF forms exactly; the remaining global contour queue is not accepted by this batch.

Author screenshot identifies a transverse construction step on the inner bowl/stem transition of Italic ч. Replace the entire short donor join by one convex quadratic; preserve all surrounding points and all other glyphs, metrics and shaping. Add a targeted transverse-step regression and exact CFF export.

Freeze final build, remove only redundant vector points without changing accepted forms; identify Cyrillic author as Yerbolat Rakhatuly (DEW), retain upstream OFL notices; push build and make repository private.
Author selected El Arch 2 for an optional writing form: embed only in Italic as ss10/aalt, retain the default el and all existing default outlines/metrics/layout.
